stem: Ken wants to strengthen the topic sentence of his third paragraph (sentences 8–13). Which of the following best replaces sentence 8?

options.label: A
options.text: An elevator is a feature that is popular and transparent in the AquaDom.

options.label: B
options.text: The 2,000-ton AquaDom includes features that delight its visitors.

options.label: C
options.text: One of the most popular features of the AquaDom is its two-floor transparent elevator.

options.label: D
options.text: The AquaDom is so large that seeing the entire aquarium is difficult.
